Viborg Fodsports Forening, also referred to as Viborg FF or simply VFF, is a Danish association football club based in the Central Jutland city of Viborg. The club currently competes in the Danish Superliga, the highest league of the Danish football league system. Nicknamed De Grønne, the club was founded on 1 April 1896. As of the end of their 2025–26 season, the club's only trophies are the 1999–2000 Danish Cup and the 2000 Danish Super Cup.
